description:
Several public coding-crate items omit required argument, panic, or cost sections, and four annotate their examples so they are never compiled. Complete the sections and bring the examples under the documentation build.

## Background

An example marked so the toolchain skips it is worse than no example: it looks like verified usage while being free to drift. Four public items across the LDPC encoding, trait, and 5G NR modules are annotated this way, at `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/encoding/richardson_urbanke.rs:113`, `crates/gf2-coding/src/traits.rs:279` and `:316`, and `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/nr_5g/mod.rs:1306`.

Separately, the two log-domain helpers at `crates/gf2-coding/src/grand/orbgrand.rs:852` and `:863` omit argument, example, and cost sections that the function immediately after them carries in full. The generator accessor at `crates/gf2-coding/src/ldpc/encoding/richardson_urbanke.rs:374` panics for non-systematic codes without saying so. The per-bit histogram at `crates/gf2-coding/src/modem/analysis.rs:829` omits its argument description while the function after it has one.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Both log-domain helpers state their arguments, their cost, and carry an example, matching the shape of the documented function beside them.
- [hard] REQ-02: The generator accessor states the condition under which it panics and carries an example.
- [hard] REQ-03: The per-bit histogram states its argument.
- [hard] REQ-04: The four skipped examples either compile without running, where they need a device or external data, or are made self-contained and run.
- [hard] REQ-05: No example in the crate is annotated so the toolchain skips compiling it.
- [hard] REQ-06: Every example added or converted compiles and passes as a documentation test.
- [hard] REQ-07: No example is added to an accessor, constant, simple constructor, predicate, or direct field mapping.
- [hard] REQ-08: Clippy with warnings denied and formatting pass.
title: Complete doc sections and make gf2-coding examples compile
